newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbia's Nis Jugopetrol, Vitol S.A. form JV - Tanjug.
newsitem.headline: Serbia's Nis Jugopetrol, Vitol S.A. form JV - Tanjug.

text.p: BELGRADE, April 18 (Tanjug) - Serbia's oil company NIS Jugopetrol and Geneva-based oil trading firm Vitol S.A. have formed a joint venture called Eurol International, the Tanjug news agency reported Friday.
Euro International will deal with imports and exports of oil derivatives and other strategic products, it said.

"Eurol will deal with investments in new installations, transport and modernisation of distributive network within Jugopetrol. It will also ensure a better presence for Jugopetrol in the world market," the agency quoted Milos Srnic, director of Eurol for Yugoslavia, as saying.
